english.note: Use 日頭 in casual speech when referring to the sun overhead, especially in weather or daylight contexts.

exampleSentences.english: The sun is really strong today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 go3 jat6 tau4 hou2 saai3

english.note: Use 日頭 for the daylight portion of a day, especially when contrasting it with nighttime.

exampleSentences.english: The sun is so strong during the day, so don’t go out.
exampleSentences.jyutping: jat6 tau4 gam3 maang5 m4 hou2 ceot1 gaai1
